about.title: About ijara.uz
about.intro: ijara.uz is a modern and reliable rental platform across Uzbekistan.
about.missionText: We make the renting process transparent, simple, secure, and fast for both tenants and landlords.
about.why2: Direct contact with landlords without hidden fees
about.why3: Smart filters, fast search and interactive map
about.why4: Special listings for students and daily rentals
about.teamText: We are a dedicated team passionate about building exceptional digital experiences for Uzbekistan.

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.section1Text: These Terms govern the use of the ijara.uz platform and its related services.
Terms.section2Text: Users agree to provide accurate and truthful information regarding real estate listings, pricing, and terms.
Terms.section3Text: The platform serves as an information broker and strives to maintain high data quality and security.
Terms.section4Text: We reserve the right to update these terms at any time by publishing the revised version on the site.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.section1Text: We only collect data strictly necessary to provide and improve our services.
Privacy.section2Text: Your information is used solely to enhance platform functionality and personalize features.
Privacy.section3Text: We employ industry-standard encryption and security measures to protect your personal details.
Privacy.section4Text: We use cookies and local storage to store user preferences such as theme, language, and favorites.
Privacy.section5Text: For any privacy-related inquiries, reach out to our team at support@ijara.uz
